1 19.10.2023

Heard Shri B Chowdhury, learned counsel for the applicants, namely, 1. Raja Boruah and 2. Aruna Baruah, who have filed this anticipatory bail application under Section 438 of the Cr.PC praying for pre-arrest bail in connection with North Lakhimpur PS Case No.344/2023 under Sections 120(B)/420/406/323/384 of the IPC, corresponding to GR No.910/2023.
Also heard Shri B Sarma, learned Addl. Public Prosecutor, Assam who has produced the Case Diary.

The contention of the applicants is that the dispute is with regard to a marriage in which the primary allegation is against one Riju Baruah and the applicants are respectively, elder brother and mother of the said accused.
Shri Sarma, learned Addl. PP by producing the Case Diary has submitted that though there are certain materials, the primary allegation is against Shri Riju Baruah.

In view of the above, it is directed that in the event of arrest of the abovenamed applicants in connection with the aforementioned police case, they shall be released on bail on furnishing bail bond of Rs. 10,000/- (Ten thousand) each, with one surety of the like amount to the satisfaction of the Arresting Authority.
The applicants are, however, directed to appear before the IO on or before 01.11.2023 for recording their statements.
The applicants are further directed to render full cooperation with the Page No.# 3/3 investigation of the case and not to indulge in any activities detrimental to the same.
The anticipatory bail application stands disposed of.

Case Diary is returned to the learned Addl. PP.
